digest.component_or_area: API surface generator and stability checks
propositions: Return annotations are omitted from API surface snapshots although they are documented as part of the stable contract in docs/api-stability.md
The _describe_class method emits public class methods as bare parameter lists without return type information, preventing return-only contract regression detection

A return-normalization helper is needed to consistently serialize return annotations as JSON null for inspect.Signature.empty, the string 'None' for actual None annotations, and formatted strings for live and postponed annotations
Public class method descriptors must be migrated from bare parameter lists to objects with 'params' and 'return' fields to capture return types while preserving parameter information
Return-only changes to top-level callables and public class methods should be detectable as drift against the regenerated baseline
